title: Stop Doing This When Driving Over Potholes
hook: Never slam your brakes over potholes.

script.narration: Never slam your brakes over potholes.
script.visual_search: car hitting deep pothole on wet road dashboard view

script.narration: First, braking compresses your front suspension, forcing your car's weight downward. Second, this leaves your tires with zero give when they smash into the edge. Third, always release the brake just before impact so your suspension absorbs the hit freely. Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this trick? Comment yes or no.
script.visual_search: close up of car tire hitting pothole slow motion

description: Learn the right way to handle road potholes without destroying your suspension. Simple driving tips for beginners to protect your vehicle from costly alignment damage. Watch till the end for the smooth driving secret.
